# Gamitofx

> Gamitofx is a Brazilian video editor and motion designer who does retention-first editing for English-speaking educational creators in business, psychology, neuroscience and AI. All work is async and in writing; no calls needed.

## Services (USD)

- Short video (vertical, 30 s to 2 min): $75 per video, 2 revisions, 2–3 business days.
- Long-form video (horizontal, 8 to 15 min): $450 per video, 2 revisions, 5–7 business days.
- Thumbnail (2 versions for A/B testing): $40.
- Channel strategy (diagnosis, hooks, titles, retention-focused scripts, metrics review): $400 per month.

## Monthly packages (USD per month; 3/6/12-month plans save 15/20/30%)

- Shorts: 8 short videos, $600.
- Shorts Pro: 16 short videos, $1,200.
- Creator: 8 short videos, 2 long-form edits and 4 thumbnails, $1,660.
- Creator + Strategy: Creator plus monthly channel strategy, $2,060.

## Method

- Open on the payoff: the first 3 seconds show the result, not the intro.
- Light up one keyword: captions readable on mute with one highlighted word.
- Change every 2 seconds: a cut, zoom or graphic before attention drops.
